description: Indian/Kerala medication vocabulary. Generic→brand→alias mappings. Every entry has provenance.
notes: brand_aliases entries are matched with token-boundary regex, not fuzzy matching.
context_required: true means the alias only matches when a dose, form, or frequency token is also present in the clause.
phonetic_aliases are correct Malayalam phonological representations. They are NOT ASR errors.
asr_variants belong in asr_correction.py, not here.
confidence: provenance quality score — only items >= 0.90 are included.
manufacturers and evidence levels (A: NLEM 2022 + CDSCO; B: CIMS India + major AIOCD share) are preserved from the research tables and never invented.
SPECULATIVE short forms (amlo, met, rosu, escitalopram shorts) are deliberately absent.
